Select canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units for assay CHEMBL1794523. Join activities to assays filtered by assay chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1794523'. Join activities to molecule_dictionary for molecule identifiers. Inner join molecule_dictionary to compound_structures for canonical SMILES. Filter to exact measurements only: standard_relation = '=' and standard_value is not null and standard_relation is not null. Keep every qualifying activity row; do not use DISTINCT. Sort by canonical_smiles, molecule_chembl_id, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units.
